title: Onboard aurelia-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add aurelia-13b v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata, validated performance profiles for common deployment shapes, and automated changelog/release-note generation. This PR bundles model metadata (model card), hardware-specific perf profiles (T4/V100/A100), a small validation suite, and a lightweight changelog generator that hooks into existing registry release workflows. What I changed: added canonical metadata.json and model card for aurelia-13b v1.0; added perf profile YAMLs covering sequence lengths 128/512/2048 and batch sizes used by Dedicated and Hosted benchmarks; implemented a changelog generator (scripts/gen_changelog.py) that emits release notes from model metadata and perf delta annotations; updated the onboarding docs with step-by-step validation guidance; added CI workflow to run profile validation and quick perf smoke tests on PRs. Testing: unit tests for profile schema, small end-to-end validation that runs a short inference on a dev image (mocked weights) to ensure shapes/configs are valid, and integration test for changelog generation. Rollout notes: model is staged to the registry in draft state; release automation will publish the changelog entry on merge. Checklist: [x] metadata + model card added; [x] perf profiles added for T4/V100/A100; [x] schema + unit tests; [x] changelog generator implemented and wired to CI; [x] docs updated; [x] reviewers added. Related work: ENG-4821 (model onboarding improvements), ENG-3910 (perf profile schema v2).
commits: Add aurelia-13b v1.0 metadata and model card
Add CI workflow for profile validation and changelog smoke tests
Update docs: model-onboarding.md guidance and examples
review_conversation: Ravi Singh (reviewer): Can you include perf numbers for sequence length 2048 on A100? We need that for Dedicated sizing. Response: Added 2048 runs to the perf YAML; numbers are from the internal perf lab (see perf/profiles/aurelia-13b-v1.0.yaml) and include 95th percentile tail latency.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Please add a short validation in CI to fail if profile schema changes. Response: Added schema unit test and CI matrix entry to model-onboard.yml.

Dana Chen (reviewer): Changelog generator looks good, but ensure entries include a perf delta summary (baseline vs this model). Response: Generator now supports perf_delta annotations in metadata and emits a small table in the changelog entry.
Maya Patel (author): Addressed all feedback, pushed fixes, and added test coverage for changelog formatting. Approvals: Ravi approved; Liam approved; Dana approved. Merge: squash and merge by Maya.
release_notes: Onboard aurelia-13b v1.0 to model registry: includes model card, validated perf profiles for common GPU shapes (T4/V100/A100) and an automated changelog generator that will publish release notes with perf deltas on merge. See docs/model-onboarding.md for validation steps.
